roleHelp.admin: Administrator: manages everything, including users and the radio.
roleHelp.member: Member: reads and sends messages, edits contacts and channels.
roleHelp.viewer: Viewer: reads messages, including direct messages, but cannot send.
roleHelp.kiosk: Kiosk: read-only wall display with no password and no direct messages.

profile.title: My account
profile.noPassword: This account has no password here: it signs in another way.

sessions.title: My sessions
sessions.help: The devices signed in to your account. Revoke one you no longer use or do not recognise.
sessions.othersRevoked: Signed out of your other sessions.
sessions.signOutOthersHelp: Every other device signed in to your account is signed out. This device stays signed in.

users.title: Users
users.help: Every account of this Meshloom. Changing a role or disabling an account signs that user out everywhere.
users.mustChange: Ask for a new password at the next sign-in
users.createHelp: A kiosk has no password. Other roles need an initial password.
users.resetHelp: The user is signed out everywhere and uses this password to sign in again.
users.deleteHelp: The account and its sessions are removed. This cannot be undone.
users.disableHelp: The user is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until you enable the account again.
users.revokeHelp: Every session of this user ends now. They can sign in again.

sessionLifetime.title: Session lifetime
sessionLifetime.days: Days a "Keep me signed in" session lasts
sessionLifetime.help: Between {{min}} and {{max}} days. A session lasts that long after its last visit; using it again starts the count over. It applies to new sessions at once and to existing ones the next time they are used. A sign-in without "Keep me signed in" still ends after at most 12 hours without a visit.
sessionLifetime.invalid: Enter a whole number of days from {{min}} to {{max}}.

ingress.title: Home Assistant sign-in
ingress.defaultRole: Role of a new Home Assistant user
ingress.help: Applies to a Home Assistant user seen for the first time. The very first one is always an administrator.
ingress.proxiesPrefix: Reverse proxies you trust are set in
